Needed to replace previous Weber that was damaged by fallen trees that was 7 years old.
This new edition Spirit II is a new design with a better side mount for propane tank. Much easier to attach than the inside the cabinet edition. It is an evolutionary design with the simple table underneath rather than a clunky cabinet. I have used it over 20x in the month I have had it and I am happy. Just the right size for cooking for one or 6.

Results.ReviewText:
I love Weber Grills, and have owned several. I decided to replace my aging Weber propane grill with a new one and decided to buy it through Weber.com.

Big mistake. I knew I would have to put it together, so when I received it, I opened the box and the second part I took from the box was broken. There are dozens of parts, so at this point I decided I made an error by ordering from Weber.com, and called them to pick up my damaged product.

The first call ended with the CS rep saying he needed to 'escalate' my call because I wasn't willing to unpack the entire box and check if other parts were damaged. Escalation meant I would receive a call or email within 24 hours.

Seventy-two hours later I called and talked to a different CS rep who told me the first rep didn't escalate my request correctly, but now he was correcting it, and expect a call or email within 24 hours.

Ten days lately... nothing.

I have now initiated a complaint with PayPal. I am also on the phone with Weber right now, on hold, waiting for a supervisor.

Just buy it assembled at Home Depot
Results.Title: Terrible experience: buy at Home Depot!

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
